name: Reg Query (SA)
help: Query the Windows registry for keys and values
long_help: Reads registry keys and values from local or remote systems. Can enumerate subkeys and values at a path, or retrieve a specific value. Supports recursive enumeration. Displays value names, types, and data along with last modified timestamps.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target hostname for remote registry (empty for local)

arguments.name: hive
arguments.desc: Hive identifier: 0 = HKCR, 1 = HKCU, 2 = HKLM, 3 = HKU

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: Value name to retrieve (empty to enumerate all values/subkeys)

arguments.name: recursive
arguments.desc: Enumerate subkeys recursively (0=no, 1=yes). Only applies when key is empty. Default: 0
